en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with two‑ to three‑story buildings and shops. A tall church‑like tower with a cross on top stands on the left side. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and in the street, and trees line the right side next to a street lamp. The printed caption at the top reads "Finsterwalde, N.-L. — Berliner Straße". Shop signs are visible on the left façades.
